title: Model Workflow Roles and Prompt Families
purpose: Data-only seed map that defines how LLMGameCreator should use different local or remote models for design discussion, batch generation, repair, validation assistance, scoring and prompt/context selection without treating model output as trusted runtime state.
principles: Model choice is role-based: the same project may use a larger creative model for design discussion and a smaller faster model for batch generation.
No model output is trusted until parsed, normalized, validated and promoted through artifact contracts and validation pipeline gates.
Prompt strictness depends on the role: creative discussion may be flexible, batch JSON generation must be contract-bound and enum-preserving.
Context is selected by capability, artifact contract, tags, project profile, current task and validation failure, not by dumping the entire project into the prompt.
Adult/NSFW content may be generated only when an explicit project/profile content overlay enables it; such output remains tagged, filterable, export-aware and separate from core mechanics.
Models may propose Lua modules, atlas patches or Unity IR, but C# validators and human approval own activation and runtime/export gates.
Repair loops must be bounded, logged and targeted at specific validation failures; they must not ask the model to redesign unrelated systems.

model_tiers.title: Designer Large Model
model_tiers.example_local_model: Gemma 4 26B A4B Instruct Ultra Uncensored Heretic
model_tiers.recommended_context_budget: 24k-64k when needed, with selected design context instead of full project dumps
model_tiers.recommended_temperature_policy: moderate for brainstorming, lower for structured specs

model_tiers.title: Batch Small/Fast Model
model_tiers.example_local_model: Gemma 4 E4B Instruct Ultra Uncensored Heretic
model_tiers.recommended_temperature_policy: low to moderate; prefer contract discipline over maximum creativity

model_tiers.title: Validator/Scorer Assistant Model
model_tiers.example_local_model: small or medium local model, optional
model_tiers.recommended_context_budget: small targeted context containing artifact, schema and validation report

workflow_roles.title: Designer LLM
workflow_roles.purpose: Discusses game concepts, lore, tone, factions, core mechanics, content overlays and high-level profiles with the user.

workflow_roles.title: Batch Generator LLM
workflow_roles.purpose: Produces many small contract-bound JSON artifacts or semantic records from approved context and strict prompts.
must_not: invent new canon unless requested via proposed_new_facts
mix multiple unrelated contracts in one response

workflow_roles.title: Repair LLM
workflow_roles.purpose: Repairs a failed artifact using the original output, validation diagnostics and exact contract rules, without redesigning unrelated content.
must_not: add new facts to fix validation unless the diagnostic explicitly requests it

workflow_roles.title: Context Selector
workflow_roles.purpose: Selects relevant context packs, atlas sections, schemas and lore snippets for a task. Deterministic tag selection should run before optional LLM ranking.
must_not: include all project data by default

workflow_roles.title: Deterministic Validator Service
workflow_roles.purpose: Performs authoritative JSON/schema/id/reference/contract/safety/export validation. This role is deterministic C# or tooling, not model judgment.
must_not: delegate final pass/fail to an LLM
required_gates: all configured validation levels for target contract

workflow_roles.title: Quality Scorer LLM
workflow_roles.purpose: Adds non-authoritative quality notes and sampling review signals for style, repetition, semantic plausibility and player-facing readability.

prompt_families.title: Design Discussion Prompt
prompt_families.output_mode: structured notes or one named artifact draft

prompt_families.title: Strict Single JSON Artifact Prompt
prompt_families.output_mode: exactly one JSON object, no markdown, no comments, no surrounding prose

prompt_families.title: Lua Module Proposal Prompt
prompt_families.output_mode: staged proposal/spec first; source files only after spec approval

prompt_families.title: Targeted Repair Prompt
prompt_families.output_mode: same artifact shape as failed artifact

prompt_families.title: Quality Sample Review Prompt
prompt_families.output_mode: JSON report with scores and notes

strict_single_json_rules: Do not wrap the response in Markdown/code fences.
Do not add explanations before or after JSON.
Copy exact input ids/enums when a field says copy_exact=true.
Use proposed_new_facts only for clearly marked optional suggestions; never treat them as approved canon.
When adult/NSFW overlay is disabled, do not generate adult/NSFW content or asset requests.
When adult/NSFW overlay is enabled, tag relevant records explicitly and keep them export-filterable.
Prefer arrays and objects with stable keys over free-form paragraphs for runtime-facing data.
If the contract cannot be satisfied, return a valid JSON object with ok=false and diagnostics, if the contract allows it.

default_order: previous approved artifacts relevant to the same ids
validation failure report for repair tasks
exclude_by_default: raw generated artifacts not approved or not needed
large asset lists unless the task targets assets
selection_methods: optional LLM ranking only after deterministic shortlist

nsfw_overlay_policy.default_state: disabled unless explicit project/profile overlay enables it
must_not: hide NSFW content in neutral tags
generate media requests when target export forbids them

next_recommended_seed.purpose: Define how selected context packs are assembled, cached, versioned and attached to model roles without dumping the whole project into prompts.
